name: codescan
description: Local-first code scanning desktop tool (self-built AST rule engine).

scripts.check: pnpm check:notices && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:rust && pnpm test:rust
scripts.build:app: pnpm run generate:notices && pnpm --filter @codescan/desktop tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.build:dmg: pnpm run generate:notices && pnpm run generate:release-config && pnpm --filter @codescan/desktop tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.ci.conf.json
scripts.scan:sarif: mkdir -p artifacts && cargo run -q -p codescan-cli -- scan . --format sarif --out artifacts/codescan.sarif && echo 'SARIF: artifacts/codescan.sarif'
